name: claude-design
description: Claude Design methodology — UI prototypes, slide decks, A4 documents, and free-form graphics with PowerPoint conversion. Provides 13 specialized sub-agents (project-planner, design-system-manager, slide-deck, slide-qa, slide-pptx, prototype, document, other, visual-refiner + optional copywriting/animation/responsive/accessibility). v1.1: density rules (overflow decision tree, D1/D2/D3 tiers), table & diagram layouts, chart value-to-pixel scaling, slide-lint build gate.
